description: SYNTHETIC: the stand's builtin calculator (safe arithmetic); any expression accepted, the final number is checked.

messages.content: You are an assistant that must use the calculator tool for every arithmetic step.
A customer buys 17 notebooks at 23.40 EUR each. Add 8% sales tax to the total. Use the calculator, then give the amount rounded to cents on a last line of the form 'ANSWER: <amount>'.

function.name: calculator
function.description: Evaluate an arithmetic expression with + - * / // % ** and parentheses.
